summary: The dossiers got the roster, coach, 22-60 record, Specter reveal and Cup group right. They also had real errors. Beam Team was pinned on the 2001-02 team in two dossiers. Dimple Records closed in 2019 (checked live) yet anchors the strategy record-store play. Heart Health Park, Tower Cafe, Ace of Spades, Del Paso Boulevard and UC Davis arena were mislabeled. The Cup was described as five Friday home games. Several files said Sacramento has no other major-league team, despite the Athletics. Fixed in place across 10 dossiers. Strategy.json still needs edits for Dimple, the Athletics line, the Oct 8 preseason window, Cup home dates, Sol Collective's location, Mulvaney's handover and Kevin Johnson's brand risk. Fragile small businesses and festival dates are queued as unverifiable.
